oauth2_validate_token_correct.label: OAuth2 - Validate Token (CORRECT)
oauth2_validate_token_correct.note: For validate_token operation, you DO NOT need authorization code. Only the token field is used.

oauth2_get_access_token_requires_code.label: OAuth2 - Get Access Token (REQUIRES CODE)
oauth2_get_access_token_requires_code.note: WARNING: get_access_token with authorization_code REQUIRES the 'code' field. Use validate_token instead if you just want to check token format.

oauth2_client_credentials_no_code.label: OAuth2 - Client Credentials (NO CODE NEEDED)
oauth2_client_credentials_no_code.note: Client credentials grant type does NOT require authorization code. But you need real OAuth provider credentials.
